_about: Public-domain Leonard Withington (1789-1885), Congregational minister of the First Church, Newbury, for the Word Hoard: Solomon's Song Translated and Explained, and his sermons (1827-1853). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 98 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
